summary: Phase 2 frontend test (empty/loading/error states and colours) on campaigns, inbox, wallet, audio, number logs, dashboard, AI agents (agents/calls/DNC), Quick IVR call, Text calls and Settings, using Bob (empty account) and Alice (populated), at 1920 and 390px. Every requested empty state, next-step button and focus/navigation target works. Grey placeholder blocks appear inside aria-busy containers while slowed APIs load, with no overlap, and real content replaces them. Error + 'Try again' works on campaigns, audio and wallet. Settings placeholder cards and the #webhooks hash scroll work. Palette is clean (indigo, plus rose/amber/green only where intended). No horizontal overflow at 390px. Issues found: (1) on an API error, campaigns and audio show the error AND the 'No ... yet' empty state at the same time; (2) when switching inbox filters, the old list stays on screen under the new chip with no loading cue; (3) several cards using space-y-* have 0px gaps on preview, so items touch (Quick IVR call sections, Settings Change password / Two-step / Default AI voice / Install app); (4) copy says 'sms' instead of 'SMS'.

ui_bugs.issue: When GET /campaigns or /audio fails, ErrorNote shows and the empty state ('No campaigns yet' / 'No audio yet' with create buttons) also shows below it. The empty check is `!list.length` and does not look at `error`. This wrongly tells the user they have no data. Wallet handles it correctly (error only).

useApi path changes with the filter (&kind=sms), but the condition is `loading && !data`. The previous filter's items stay visible under the newly selected chip until the new response arrives, with no placeholder or spinner. With a 3s delay on mobile, the SMS chip showed Bob's coupon items. Show placeholders or an inline spinner while `loading` is true after the path changes, or clear the data when the path changes.

The 'No sms yet' log empty state reuses the generic sub-line 'Calls, texts and voicemails show up here...'

not_verified: Alice on this pod has no campaigns, audio or AI agents, and no wallet credits (only debits). Populated campaign rows/pills, audio rows, agent cards and the green credit amount could not be seen in the UI (verified in code only).
action_items: Campaigns.js and AudioLibrary.js (and any other list using the same pattern): don't render Empty when `error` is set and data is null, e.g. `error && !data ? null : ...`
Inbox.js: show SkeletonRows or an inline spinner while `loading` is true after a filter change, instead of the stale list
Replace space-y-* with flex flex-col gap-* in the QuickCall Section component and the Settings Change password, Two-step, Default AI voice and Install app cards
Copy: 'sms' -> 'SMS' in inbox and log empty titles
critical_code_review_comments: useApi runs twice in dev StrictMode, so a 'fail once' route mock is hidden by the second successful request. To test error states, fail every request until you click retry.
useApi keeps old data across path changes, which is the root cause of the stale inbox filter list.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all requested flows pass; 2 state-logic bugs + spacing/copy issues)

seed_data_creation: None. No payments or TTS were triggered.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login: fill auth-email-input and input[type=password], then get_by_role('button', name='Sign in'), then wait_for_url('**/cloudivr/app**'). In route-delay handlers, wrap route.continue_() in try/except. On this pod Alice has number +13313039039, $330, 8 inbox items, no campaigns/audio/agents/logs.
